plaque: A bridge over nothing at all, lit by lanterns paid for by the families of those who fell.
names: Names are etched under each lantern. The newest plate is blank, polished and already paid for.
lamplighter: Lamplighter Mireille: I light one lantern for every fall. Business has never been better.
Mireille: The families pay. Veronne collects. I just hold the match.
